notes.text: Assumed the compiler emits no error (and at most an analyzer warning) for Monitor.Enter(count) with an int argument, so the snippet builds and fails at run time with System.Threading.SynchronizationLockException thrown from Monitor.Exit in finally. Confirm with run-snippets.
Claim that lock (count) on an int is compile error CS0185 is from memory; verify the exact error code.
bugLineSets accepts {13,20}, {13} alone and {20} alone (Enter and Exit lines). Recount: line 13 is Monitor.Enter(count); line 20 is Monitor.Exit(count). Owner may prefer only [[13, 20]].
Implicit usings of a console project are assumed to include System.Threading, so Monitor resolves without a using directive.
